items.headline: Planning Commission agenda: 316 apartments proposed on golf course site at 400 Saratoga Avenue
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a public hearing on a recommendation for a General Plan amendment and rezone at 400 Saratoga Avenue. The proposal would build a five-story, 316-unit apartment building, reconfigure the existing nine-hole golf course, and dedicate land for a public park. An environmental impact report was prepared and circulated for public review.

items.headline: Agenda listed condo map for 14 townhomes and a duplex near Civic Center Drive
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The project includes 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space. It was listed as exempt from CEQA under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Council agenda listed closed-session talks on two lawsuits against Cupertino
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed a closed-session conference with legal counsel on two Santa Clara County Superior Court lawsuits against Cupertino, brought by Lixin (Leon) Chen and others and by Yes in My Backyard and others. The agenda gives no details on the claims.

items.headline: Council agenda listed ordinance changing City Council compensation
items.summary: The November 17 agenda included consideration of an ordinance amending Cupertino Municipal Code Section 2.16.020 on City Council compensation. The agenda text does not say what the amounts or changes would be.

items.headline: Council agenda listed changes to community funding and festival fee waivers
items.summary: The November 17 agenda included consideration of council subcommittee recommendations on the Community Funding Policy and on festival fee waivers. These policies govern city support for community groups and events.

items.headline: Council agenda listed deferral of 590-unit El Camino Real project
items.summary: The November 17 City Council/Stadium Authority agenda listed an action to defer consideration of a vesting tentative subdivision map and development agreement for a 590-unit residential and 15,000-square-foot commercial mixed-use project at 2610 El Camino Real. The project is subject to SB 330 (2019).

items.headline: Ethics committee agenda: updates to gift policy for city officials
items.summary: The Governance and Ethics Committee's November 16 agenda listed proposed updates to Council Policy 050, which covers gifts to elected and appointed officials. It also listed updates to Council Policy 030, on adding an item to the agenda, which had been deferred from June 1.

items.headline: Campbell Planning Commission agenda listed two permit-streamlining reports
items.summary: The November 10 agenda listed reports from two Planning Commission ad hoc subcommittees. One plans to interview developers and stakeholders about housing production bottlenecks and propose policies. The other is researching ways to streamline Conditional Use Permits to support business development.
